content: सभाज् €10 <ab>U.</ab> (सभाजयति-ते) .²1 To salute, pay respects, greet, render homage to, congratulate; स्नेहात् सभाजयितुमेत्य <ls>U. 1. 7</ls>; <ls>Śi. 13. 14</ls>; <ls>Ś. 5</ls>. .²2 To honour, worship, respect. .²3 To please, gratify. .²4 To beautify, adorn, grace; बटुपरिषदं पुण्यश्रीकः श्रियेव सभाजयन् <ls>U. 4. 19</ls>. .²5 To show.
